newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Unigate Plc ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Unigate Plc ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Monday it had affirmed its A long-term and A1 short-term ratings for Unigate Plc.
"Unigate's concentration on building up its yellow fats and pork processing operations has helped to offset difficult conditions in parts of the dairy industry," IBCA said in a statement.
"Although the decline in doorstep milk deliveries is continuing, Unigate has taken cost-cutting measures to protect margins," the rating agency said.
"The BSE scare has boosted demand for pork and it should not be adversely affected in any way, provided there is no wholesale slaughter of dairy cattle from infected herds," said IBCA.

"The company remains in a net cash position following the sale of its stake in Nutricia and two chains of U.S. restaurants, which gives it the flexibility to make focused acquisitions in fresh foods and distribution," IBCA said.
